When a group of offworlders infiltrated an analysis center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]], they were detected by a military supervisor who attacked them with his supporting [[O'reenian]] [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]. During the '''skirmish''', a dozen O'reenian researchers were defeated by the offworlders, who also recovered a [[tactical data core]] they were seeking.
